title: Tar Pit Lantern
description: A sustained subtractive saw drone in the low register, thickened with a detuned echo and ground down with soft drive and bitcrush for a gritty character. Over 32 cycles the ladder filter slowly opens and closes while resonance breathes and dual pan LFOs drift the body and its octave ghost across the stereo field.
code:
setcpm(120/4)
stack(
  note("<c1 c1 eb1 g0>/4").s("sawtooth")
    .add(note("0,0.08"))
    .lpf(sine.slow(32).range(180, 1700)).resonance(sine.slow(13).range(6, 17)).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(2).lpattack(0.02).lpdecay(0.4)
    .crush("<10 8 7 9>/8").shape(sine.slow(24).range(0.2, 0.55))
    .vib("<0.2 0.4 0.3>/8").vibmod(sine.slow(17).range(0.1, 0.7))
    .attack(0.05).decay(0.3).sustain(0.8).release(0.4)
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .off(1/4, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.3).pan(saw.slow(9).range(0.85, 0.15)).hpf(400))
    .room(0.25).gain(0.9)
)
